name: Tina Funiciello
office: City of Rancho Palos Verdes, Member of the City Council

items.text: Tina Funiciello is an attorney running for Rancho Palos Verdes City Council. Her campaign says she supports maintaining zoning to preserve natural beauty and protecting neighborhood character.

sentences.text: Tina Funiciello is an attorney running for Rancho Palos Verdes City Council.
Her campaign says she supports maintaining zoning to preserve natural beauty and protecting neighborhood character.

items.text: At an October 2026 candidate forum, she identified landslide recovery as the top issue, along with infrastructure, public safety and disaster preparedness. She called for stabilizing land, protecting critical infrastructure and seeking outside funding without draining city resources. She also listed fiscal sustainability and aging infrastructure like roads, storm drains and sewers as priorities.
